message: Yeah, comment spam is a pain, and all the spammers are doing is trying to use my site as a sort of billboard by which to raise their Google pagerank: talk about obnoxious. If you're really bored, you can take a look at the 1218 words and URLs that are blocked from posting comments here, at [http://www.vitia.org/blacklist.txt](http://www.vitia.org/blacklist.txt). The way I've got it set up, comments on posts more than 30 days old are supposed to be blocked, but apparently it's not working. Something to look into.
